Photo 1 shows the same valve body from a slightly different angle, with a hand holding a tool near the center, suggesting maintenance or repair work.
Photo 2 shows the valve body from the side, with a hand holding the casing, revealing the internal components and the black connector.
The valve body appears to be removed from a car engine, likely a manual or automatic transmission, given the complexity and presence of a solenoid and wiring harness.
